name: Dyess AFB
description: Home of the 7th Bomb Wing and 317th Airlift Wing. Dyess AFB operates B-1B Lancer and C-130J Super Hercules aircraft, supporting global strike and mobility missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Tye Gate
gates.notes: Alternate access. Closed weekends and holidays.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 9265)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-2100; closed weekends, holidays, and family days
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Located at 1518 E. Arnold Blvd.
gates.address: 1518 E. Arnold Blvd, Bldg 9265, Dyess AFB, TX 79607

resources.name: Longhorn Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting the 7th Bomb Wing and 317th Airlift Wing with full meal service.

resources.name: Dyess Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Communities of Abilene Federal Credit Union
resources.description: Full-service credit union branch on base with ATM.

resources.name: Dyess Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with weights, cardio, group exercise, basketball, racquetball, lap pool, and 24/7 access for registered CAC holders.
resources.hours: 24/7 for registered users; staffed hours vary

resources.name: Dyess Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.name: 7th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: See directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Dyess Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 7th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 9265)
primaryAction.address: 1518 E. Arnold Blvd, Bldg 9265, Dyess AFB, TX 79607

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dyess Inn (325-696-2681) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (325-696-4403) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 7 FSS, M&FRC, and official Dyess sites for in-processing and community support.
